#PROBLEM 1
```{r}
# Read annual PC2 volatility
PC2_annual <- read_excel(
  "Zero_Coupon_1961_PC_Volatility.xlsx",
  sheet = "PC2 Annual"
)


PC2_annual <- PC2_annual[
  PC2_annual$Year >= 1962 & PC2_annual$Year <= 2025,
]

V_PC2 <- PC2_annual$`PC2 Log Volatility`


ln_V_PC2 <- log(V_PC2)

# Creating one-year lag
ln_V_PC2_lag <- c(
  NA,
  ln_V_PC2[-length(ln_V_PC2)]
)

# Fitting AR(1)
AR1_PC2 <- lm(
  ln_V_PC2 ~ ln_V_PC2_lag
)

summary(AR1_PC2)

# Innovations
Z_PC2 <- residuals(AR1_PC2)

# ACF of Z(t)
acf(Z_PC2, main = "ACF of Z(t) - PC2")

# ACF of absolute Z(t)
acf(abs(Z_PC2), main = "ACF of |Z(t)| - PC2")

# QQ plot
qqnorm(Z_PC2, main = "QQ Plot of Z(t) - PC2")
qqline(Z_PC2)

# Normality tests
shapiro.test(Z_PC2)

library(tseries)
jarque.bera.test(Z_PC2)

# Ljung-Box tests for Z(t)
Box.test(Z_PC2, lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(Z_PC2, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")

# Ljung-Box tests for |Z(t)|
Box.test(abs(Z_PC2), lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(abs(Z_PC2), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
```

#NORmaliizng by stock
```{r}
# Reading S&P volatility data
SP_data <- read_excel(
  "full-data.xlsx",
  sheet = "data"
)

# Years corresponding to the AR(1) innovations
Z_data <- data.frame(
  Year = PC2_annual$Year[-1],
  Z_PC2 = Z_PC2
)

# Match innovations with S&P volatility by year
PC2_SP <- merge(
  Z_data,
  SP_data[, c("Year", "Volatility")],
  by = "Year"
)

# S&P volatility
SP_Vt <- PC2_SP$Volatility

# Dividing the innovation by S&P volatility
# This corresponds to dividing the original AR(1) equation by V_SP,t
Wt <- PC2_SP$Z_PC2 / SP_Vt


# Testing W(t) for IID Gaussian behavior

acf(Wt, main = "ACF of W(t)")

acf(abs(Wt), main = "ACF of |W(t)|")

qqnorm(Wt, main = "QQ Plot of W(t)")
qqline(Wt)

shapiro.test(Wt)

jarque.bera.test(Wt)

Box.test(Wt, lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(Wt, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")

Box.test(abs(Wt), lag = 5, type = "Ljung-Box")
Box.test(abs(Wt), lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box")
```
